children: The offshore yuan eased to around 6.71 per dollar on Friday and was heading for weekly losses as traders weighed developments from the Trump-Xi summit in Washington.
Artificial intelligence was a central topic during Thursday’s White House meeting, with both leaders discussing how to manage competition in the rapidly evolving sector.

Ahead of the talks, Trump reiterated his opposition to stricter AI guardrails, while Xi said both countries have the “capability and responsibility” to ensure the technology remains under human control.
Separately, Xi urged the US to explicitly oppose Taiwan independence, marking his first public appeal for Trump to reconsider Washington’s longstanding stance on the self-governed island.
The White House has yet to release an official readout of the meeting, leaving Trump's response unclear.
Externally, the yuan remained under pressure from a firmer US dollar as markets priced in around a 67% chance of a Federal Reserve rate hike in October.

title: Yuan Eases as Traders Weigh Trump-Xi Meeting
